answer_1.quote: Generating abstractive summaries can help readers quickly grasp the main topics, yet prior work has mostly focused on short texts... We fine-tune BART for all experiments.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE and human evaluation, we extend existing QA-based metric ... and consider an entailment-based scorer. We also report ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, APES, APES_src, and FactCC scores.

answer_4.quote: Human judges further rate the summaries generated by our models to be more informative and faithful. Human evaluation results on informativeness and unfaithful errors are reported.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to label each summary sentence with an aspect and then decide whether it contains any type of error. They also score aspect-level informativeness of the summary.
